def config_value(text: str, key: str) -> str:
    """Value for `key` in `name=value` per-line config text, or "" when absent.

    Each line is split at its first "=". Name and value are stripped of
    surrounding whitespace. Lines without "=" are ignored. If the key
    appears more than once, the first occurrence wins.
    """
    ex config_value(text="a=1\nb=2", key="b") == "2"
    ex config_value(text="a=1\nb=2", key="c") == ""
    ex config_value(text="a = 1\na=2", key="a") == "1"
    ex config_value(text="x=a=b", key="x") == "a=b"
    ex config_value(text="junk\nk=v", key="k") == "v"
    ex config_value(text="", key="a") == ""
    for raw in text.splitlines():
        name, sep, val = raw.partition("=")
        if sep == "":
            continue
        if name.strip() == key:
            return val.strip().copy()
    return ""
